headline: BSE Shares Rally Over 2% Following Brokerage Upgrade and Higher Price Target
summary: BSE shares advanced as much as 2.2% after HDFC Securities upgraded the stock to Buy and raised its price target to Rs 4,450, citing a recovery in trading volumes and regulatory support.
why: Analyst target upgrades and volume recovery projections can stimulate institutional buying and short-term momentum in exchange operator equities.

impacts.name: BSE Limited
impacts.why: Brokerage upgrades and higher price targets attract investor purchases, lifting share prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
